chapters.premise: Roshan arrives at the dusty Pearl Castle and cleans it room by room: Bubble Bathroom (tutorial), Sparkle Pool, Stuffie Room and Art Room. The boss door then glows and she faces Grand Puff alone.
chapters.entry_condition: A new game: start menu, then the opening story clip.
chapters.end_state: Grand Puff is beaten (day_one_giant_dust_bunny_boss_defeated). The transformation clip shows the family joining; the Rainbow Friend then follows Roshan. The Day Two transition bridges into the birthday.
chapters.ending_obligation: Chapter 2 starts from the cleaned castle; Grand Puff is a friend, not a defeated enemy; the Rainbow Friend is present afterwards.

chapters.proposed_name: Chapter 2: Day Two, Roshan's birthday party
chapters.premise: Eight ordered party jobs build one birthday: Farmer, Pastry Chef, Candy Maker, Painter, Ballerina, Pop Star, Astronaut Engineer, Detective. Roshan puts on her special dress before the party. On the Sky Lagoon lawn she protects her friends; the rocket she built lights the rainbow candle (provisional in the lawn-finale draft); the Ember King cheats and carries the lit candle away for his own birthday, leaving the cake and preparations intact. His son, the Prince, is kind and conflicted about his father.
chapters.entry_condition: Day One complete (Grand Puff beaten), reached through the Day Two transition.
chapters.end_state: chapter2_story_complete and chapter2_candle_taken are saved; the lawn finale plays; the free-play career cards appear.
chapters.ending_obligation: The candle is gone and the Ember King has it. Chapter 3's reveal requires both saved facts.
